author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam and Norm unbox and scrutinize Tomy's 1:350 USS Enterprise Refit model! From its heavy diecast parts to the clever illumination design, the scale and detail of this model brings us right back to the ship's glorious reveal in Star Trek: The Motion Picture. Tomy really outdid themselves with this release and it gets us even more excited for their future Star Trek ships!

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
